❓ Frequently asked questions

How is dividend yield calculated?

Annual dividend per share ÷ share price × 100. A $2 dividend on a $50 stock is a 4% yield.

Does yield change if the price moves?

Yes — yield and price move inversely. A falling price raises the yield on new purchases but may signal a coming dividend cut.

Is a high yield always better?

No. Very high yields can mean the market expects the dividend to be cut. Check payout ratio and company health too.
